verdict.rationale: The docs show the platform can use any OAuth 2.0 provider to authenticate MCP servers (gram-docs-2, gram-docs-15). They also say a governed endpoint applies upstream credentials to third-party servers (gram-docs-3, gram-docs-13), which suggests some downstream credential handling. However, none of the evidence shows the platform running OAuth flows on behalf of downstream tools, storing tokens encrypted, or refreshing them automatically. Missing for 10: platform-brokered downstream OAuth flows, encrypted credential vaulting, automatic token refresh, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
